# HeroUI v3 React development guide

Curated by Skill Harbor — ⚠️ **Security warning / Avertissement de sécurité** : the guide documents a one-liner install piped from curl into bash (`curl -fsSL https://heroui.com/install | bash — review it before running; the guide also documents an npm alternative`) — **prefer the npm install also documented in the same guide** (`npm i @heroui/styles @heroui/react tailwind-variants`), which is the safe path. Apart from that, this is @heroui-inc's official development guide for HeroUI v3, the React component library on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria: v3-vs-v2 migration rules (no provider, compound components, CSS-based animations, semantic variants), framework setup (Next.js App Router, globals.css, PostCSS), component patterns, oklch CSS-variable theming, and helper scripts plus MDX docs to fetch per-component documentation before implementing. Honest caveats: **v3 only** — the guide explicitly warns that v2 patterns do not apply; Tailwind CSS v4 is mandatory; Apache-2.0 licensed; the skill expects the agent to fetch docs from heroui.com. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
